params.detail: Follow the coolant run-off line north.
Something hunts in the dark. Destroy the drones.
The run-off line opens into the reclamation cistern. Repair first if you need it ({interact} at the station).
Troopers hold the far side. Destroy them all.
A maintenance shaft at the end of the drain.
